summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 installation checklist published
summary.summary: A new checklist documents installing Configuration Manager current-branch update 2603, including early-ring opt-in, hierarchy and site-system behavior, prerequisites, backup, replication, ADK, and update-installation checks. The update applies to sites on version 2409 or later.
summary.adminImpact: Use the checklist to validate prerequisites and maintenance planning before installing 2603, particularly for multi-site hierarchies and early-ring enrollment.

summary.headline: Microsoft Tunnel May 1 release notes added
summary.summary: The Microsoft Tunnel upgrade article adds a May 1, 2026 release-notes section for version 20260407.1 and its image hashes.
summary.adminImpact: Check the Tunnel release notes and image hashes when validating or troubleshooting this server release.

summary.headline: BitLocker pre-boot PIN changes can be audited with Event ID 789
summary.summary: The BitLocker documentation now identifies pre-boot PIN modification events in Event Viewer: Microsoft-Windows-Bitlocker-API/Management, Bitlocker PIN Modification Task category, Event ID 789.
summary.adminImpact: Use Event ID 789 in the specified log to investigate or audit pre-boot PIN changes.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 listed in supported update versions
summary.summary: The supported-versions table now lists Configuration Manager 2603 (5.00.9146.1000), with an early-ring availability date of May 5, 2026 and support through November 5, 2027. Its availability-date note now points to the 2603 checklist.
summary.adminImpact: Use the 2603 checklist and verify version eligibility before scheduling the update.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 release notes now link to the matching checklist
summary.summary: The 2603 What's New article corrects all installation and post-update checklist links from the 2509 checklist to the new 2603 checklist.
summary.adminImpact: Use the 2603 checklist rather than the older 2509 checklist to prepare and follow up on this update.

summary.headline: Several Intune 2605 capabilities added to In development
summary.summary: The in-development article adds planned macOS Wi-Fi MAC-randomization control, iOS/iPadOS 802.1X wired-network profiles, Android Enterprise Bluetooth-sharing control, Apple ADE enrollment-time grouping, and in-place renewal for eligible Cloud PKI issuing CAs.
summary.adminImpact: Evaluate these forthcoming capabilities in test plans; do not assume they are available in production yet.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 SQL Management Objects requirement corrected
summary.summary: The 2603 What's New article now says Microsoft SQL Server Management Objects and System CLR Types move from SQL Server 2014 versions to SQL Server 2025 versions (SMO 17), replacing the prior SQL Server 2016 wording.
summary.adminImpact: Review the corrected SQL component version when assessing 2603 prerequisites and compatibility.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager release notes now include 2603 What's New link
summary.summary: The release-notes index adds a link to the Configuration Manager 2603 What's New article.
summary.adminImpact: Use the 2603 What's New page with release notes when planning the update.

summary.headline: 2603 checklist removes obsolete SQL Native Client prerequisite
summary.summary: The Configuration Manager 2603 installation checklist removes the SQL Server 2012 Native Client prerequisite section while retaining the SQL ODBC driver requirement.
summary.adminImpact: Validate the remaining documented prerequisites, including the SQL ODBC driver, instead of planning a Native Client installation from this checklist.

summary.headline: Managed Home Screen suspend and restore actions removed from In development
summary.summary: The planned Android Managed Home Screen actions to temporarily suspend and restore the launcher were removed from the in-development article.
summary.adminImpact: Do not plan on those listed forthcoming actions based on the removed notice; confirm current supported remote actions before operational use.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager availability-date note no longer links to early-ring detail
summary.summary: The supported-versions page retains its explanation that availability dates refer to early-ring release but removes the hyperlink to the 2603 early-ring checklist section.
summary.adminImpact: No update behavior changed; use the 2603 checklist directly for early-ring instructions.

summary.headline: Delete-action documentation adopts Apple mobile terminology
summary.summary: The Delete device action article replaces iOS/iPadOS with Apple mobile while preserving the behavior: Delete triggers Retire for Apple mobile, macOS, and Windows; Android behavior continues to depend on enrollment type.
summary.adminImpact: No action semantics changed; update internal terminology and retain existing delete/retire procedures.

summary.headline: Improved Windows on-demand sync added to In development
summary.summary: A planned enhancement will make the Windows Sync device action perform a more comprehensive immediate synchronization across compliance, configuration policies, apps, and scripts instead of waiting for scheduled check-ins.
summary.adminImpact: Plan to validate the expanded Sync action for urgent rollouts and troubleshooting when it becomes available.

summary.headline: Wired-network reference corrected in In development
summary.summary: The planned iOS/iPadOS wired-network profile entry now links to the current wired-networks configuration article instead of a broken path.
summary.adminImpact: No feature change is described; update saved references to the corrected guidance.

summary.headline: Android settings-catalog references corrected
summary.summary: The In development entry for Android Enterprise Bluetooth sharing updates its Settings catalog and Android settings-list links to their current device-configuration locations.
summary.adminImpact: No setting behavior changed; use the corrected links when reviewing Android catalog settings.
